description: Free. The pump.fun coins a ticker or name means, newest first, so a coin named in a chat can be looked up by its mint: for each, the mint (the contract address, CA), its name and ticker, when it was created, its deployer with their launches and graduations, whether it graduated, its market cap at five minutes and its first-day peak. For: what is $KIMCHI's CA, which Kimchi is the real one, find this coin by name, the mint for this ticker. Covers every coin that completed its bonding curve (about 300K); a coin still on its curve is not here yet. A mint given as q returns that coin's name. Then launch_record on the mint.

limit.description: coins to return, newest first; default 20

q.description: a ticker ($KIMCHI or KIMCHI), a name, or a mint

name: find_coin
